new_value: Fixed. Root cause: both Rust SX126x wrappers (esp32s3.rs, stm32wl.rs) passed enable_public_network=false to lora-phy's LoRa::new, programming the private sync word 0x1424 (sx127x 0x12) while C programs 0x34 — Rust nodes deaf to C nodes. Fix (cac252b4ac): shared crate::ENABLE_PUBLIC_NETWORK selector, compile-time bound to LORA_SYNC_WORD == 0x34, used at both call sites; host test pins constant + selector. Reviewer findings fixed inline: security pass found the pin test unreachable by CI (lichen-embassy excluded from default-members) -> 009d12beb6 adds 'cargo test -p lichen-embassy' to ci.yml; edge pass found the feature-gated call sites never compiled in CI -> a3a9ebe85b grep-pins both LoRa::new call sites through the selector. Tests: lichen-embassy 6/6 green (incl. new pin); mock/sim features compile. 3x codereview via kimi-k3 + convergence review: correctness PASS, security finding fixed, edge finding fixed, convergence PASS.
